title: Design: A/R Detail chevrons and pinned group row look as described
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The report has open documents in several buckets on today's date, one with more lines than fit on the screen.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Detail is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu in light theme at 100% zoom, with every group collapsed.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the table's top-left header cell.
  2. Look at each bucket row's own chevron.
  3. Hover over the top-left chevron button.
  4. Click it, then hover over it again.
  5. Scroll down through the tallest bucket.
  6. Switch ShopView to dark theme.
  7. Hover over the top-left chevron button.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: one chevron button, the design system's chevron icon, in the top-left header cell, pointing right (every group collapsed).
  • Step 2: every bucket row shows the same chevron, pointing right when closed.
  • Step 3: a tooltip above the button reads "Expand all", letter for letter.
  • Step 4: every bucket opens, its chevron points down, and the tooltip above the button reads "Collapse all".
  • Step 5: the bucket's row stays pinned just under the column headings, with its label visible at the left.
  • Step 6: the page switches to dark theme; the pinned row is readable.
  • Step 7: the tooltip sits above the button and is readable in dark theme.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)

  • S4-R1: “The table's top-left header cell holds one chevron button. While any group is expanded it points down, its tooltip (above the button) reads "Collapse all", and a click collapses every group. When every group is collapsed it points right, its tooltip reads "Expand all", and a click expands every group.”
  • S4-R5: “Each group's own expand toggle uses the same chevron: pointing down when open, right when closed. Behavior is unchanged.”
  • S4-R6: “While the user scrolls through an expanded group, that group's row (the bucket label, customer or vendor) stays pinned just under the column headings. Only one group row is held at a time: when the next group's row reaches it, the next row pushes it up and off and takes its place. Scrolling back reverses this.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Collapse all / Expand all button | "Collapse all" / "Expand all" | Tooltip above the button”
  • Key Decisions, reuse rule: “The reuse rule. Every control on these reports reuses an existing ShopView pattern: the native filter chips, the native totals row and pinned headline column of the newer reports, the existing location-switch prompt, the design system's chevron icon. Nothing new is drawn. Basis: d-reuse-existing-pattern.”
